name: Software Developer
description: Designs, builds, tests and maintains software applications, turning requirements into reliable, readable code.
responsibilities: Implement features from requirements and user stories
Write automated tests and fix defects
Review teammates' code and keep the codebase maintainable
Design data models and integrate with APIs and databases
Collaborate through version control and code review workflows
prerequisites: Comfort with at least one programming language
Familiarity with using a command line

suggested_projects.title: Task tracker API with tests
suggested_projects.description: Build a small REST API (create, list, update, delete tasks) backed by a SQL database, with automated tests and a README describing endpoints.

suggested_projects.title: CLI utility
suggested_projects.description: Write a command-line tool that parses a log or CSV file and reports summary statistics, with unit tests for the parsing logic.

suggested_projects.title: Contribute to open source
suggested_projects.description: Find a beginner-friendly issue in an open-source project, submit a pull request and respond to review feedback.

name: Cybersecurity Engineer
description: Protects systems, networks and data by monitoring for threats, finding weaknesses before attackers do and responding to incidents.
responsibilities: Monitor security alerts and investigate suspicious activity
Assess systems for vulnerabilities and recommend remediation
Harden servers, networks and web applications
Respond to and document security incidents
Automate security checks with scripts
prerequisites: Understanding of how computers and operating systems work
Willingness to work only in authorized lab environments

suggested_projects.title: Home security lab report
suggested_projects.description: Build an isolated virtual lab, collect logs from a Linux host, write two detection rules for suspicious activity and document an investigation of a simulated alert.

suggested_projects.title: Log analysis script
suggested_projects.description: Write a Python script that parses SSH authentication logs and flags brute-force patterns, with a short report of findings.

suggested_projects.title: Web app hardening review
suggested_projects.description: Review a deliberately vulnerable training app (e.g. OWASP Juice Shop) locally, document three vulnerability classes found and the fixes you would apply.

name: Data Analyst
description: Turns raw data into answers: cleans and queries datasets, analyses trends and communicates findings that inform decisions.
responsibilities: Query and combine data from databases and spreadsheets
Clean and validate datasets before analysis
Apply descriptive and inferential statistics
Build dashboards and visualizations for stakeholders
Present findings and recommendations clearly
prerequisites: Curiosity about how businesses measure success

suggested_projects.title: Public dataset analysis
suggested_projects.description: Pick an open dataset, clean it, answer three business questions with SQL or pandas and present the results in a short slide-style report.

suggested_projects.title: KPI dashboard
suggested_projects.description: Build an interactive dashboard tracking five KPIs from a sample sales dataset, with filters and a one-paragraph insight for each chart.

suggested_projects.title: A/B test write-up
suggested_projects.description: Analyse a sample A/B test dataset, check statistical significance and recommend a decision with caveats.

name: AI/ML Engineer
description: Builds, evaluates and deploys machine learning models, from data preparation to monitoring models in production.
responsibilities: Prepare and engineer features from raw data
Train, tune and evaluate machine learning models
Build deep learning models for unstructured data
Package and deploy models behind reliable services
Monitor model performance and data drift
prerequisites: Solid programming fundamentals, ideally in Python

suggested_projects.title: End-to-end ML pipeline
suggested_projects.description: Train a classification model on a public dataset, compare it with a baseline, track experiments and serve predictions through a small API.

suggested_projects.title: Image classifier
suggested_projects.description: Fine-tune a small pretrained neural network on an image dataset and report accuracy, a confusion matrix and failure cases.

suggested_projects.title: Model card
suggested_projects.description: Write a model card for one of your models covering intended use, metrics, limitations and fairness checks.

name: Web Developer
description: Builds fast, accessible and secure websites and web applications across the front end and back end.
responsibilities: Build responsive, accessible user interfaces
Implement interactive features with JavaScript and React
Create server-side APIs and connect databases
Optimize performance and fix cross-browser issues
Apply secure coding practices
prerequisites: Basic computer literacy and comfort with a code editor
Interest in design and user experience

suggested_projects.title: Full-stack notes app
suggested_projects.description: Build a notes app with a React front end, a Node.js API and a database, including form validation and an accessibility check.

suggested_projects.title: Portfolio site
suggested_projects.description: Create a responsive personal portfolio that scores well on a Lighthouse audit for performance and accessibility.

suggested_projects.title: Public API dashboard
suggested_projects.description: Fetch data from a public API and display it with loading, error and empty states in a typed React application.
